text: あと　やけどなおしを　もって　いった　ほうが　いいぜ！

structure.jp: やけどなおしを　もって　いった　ほうが　いいぜ！
structure.en: you'd better take a Burn Heal with you!

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: いった　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus ほうがいい gives advice: 'you'd better'. もって　いった　ほうが　いい = 'you'd better take it along'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a verb's て form shows doing it and then going. もって　いった = 'took along'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes what you say with confidence. いいぜ = 'it's better, I tell you!'.
